name: OneMillion-Bench
intro: OneMillion-Bench 是一个面向高价值专业场景的语言代理基准，覆盖法律、金融、工业、医疗和自然科学五大领域，要求代理检索权威来源、处理冲突证据并在约束条件下完成专家级开放任务。
build_method: 专家构建, rubric评测协议
metric: Factual Accuracy, Logical Coherence, Practical Feasibility, Professional Compliance
eval_feature: 权威来源检索, 冲突证据解析, 专业合规性
intro_en: OneMillion-Bench is a benchmark for language agents in economically consequential professional scenarios. It spans law, finance, industry, healthcare, and natural science, and requires authoritative retrieval, conflict resolution, and constraint-aware expert reasoning.
metric_en: Factual Accuracy, Logical Coherence, Practical Feasibility, Professional Compliance
eval_feature_en: Authoritative Retrieval, Conflicting Evidence Resolution, Professional Compliance
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["先在法律、金融、工业、医疗、自然科学五个领域定义高价值专家任务"] --> B["由领域专家整理 400 个开放式任务"]
    B --> C["为每个任务指定时间限制、引用要求与专业约束"]
    C --> D["要求代理检索权威来源并汇总证据"]
    D --> E["在冲突证据下进行规则适用与约束决策"]
    E --> F["生成完整且可执行的专业回答"]
    F --> G["按 factual accuracy、logical coherence、practical feasibility、professional compliance 打分"]
    G --> H["汇总不同领域下代理的专业可靠性与实用准备度"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define economically consequential expert tasks across law, finance, industry, healthcare, and natural science"] --> B["Curate 400 open-ended tasks with domain experts"]
    B --> C["Attach time constraints, citation requirements, and professional rules to each task"]
    C --> D["Require agents to retrieve authoritative sources and assemble evidence"]
    D --> E["Resolve conflicting evidence and make constraint-aware decisions"]
    E --> F["Produce complete, useful professional deliverables"]
    F --> G["Score outputs on factual accuracy, logical coherence, practical feasibility, and professional compliance"]
    G --> H["Aggregate agent reliability and practical readiness across domains"]
